purpose: Immutable targeted A/B rerun of fixed-ledger order 82 after a reusable Writer italic-run font-size schema and catalog-recall fix.

A regular all-paragraph 16-point request exposes paragraph.set_format and does not expose the italic-run action. task.execute is absent.
